gloss: silk thread; cocoon thread; raw silk fiber

definitions.gloss: silk thread; cocoon thread; raw silk fiber
definitions.explanation: Thread obtained from silkworm cocoons. Refers to the raw silk fiber before it is processed into fabric. An important term in the history of Japanese textile production and sericulture.

examples.japanese: {繭|まゆ}から{繭糸|けんし}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To extract silk thread from cocoons.

examples.japanese: {繭糸|けんし}の{品質|ひんしつ}は{蚕|かいこ}の{育|そだ}て{方|かた}で{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The quality of silk thread changes depending on how the silkworms are raised.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}、{日本|にほん}は{繭糸|けんし}の{輸出|ゆしゅつ}で{外貨|がいか}を{稼|かせ}いだ。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, Japan earned foreign currency through silk thread exports.

notes:
Composed of {繭|けん} (cocoon) and {糸|し} (thread). Japan has a long history of sericulture ({養蚕|ようさん}), and silk production was a major industry from the Edo period through the early twentieth century. The {富岡|とみおか}{製糸場|せいしじょう} (Tomioka Silk Mill), a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a famous example of Japan's silk industry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {繭糸|けんし}を{紡|つむ}ぐ: to spin silk thread
- {繭糸|けんし}の{生産|せいさん}: silk thread production
- {生|き}{繭糸|けんし}: raw silk thread
- {繭糸|けんし}の{品質|ひんしつ}: silk thread quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生糸|きいと}: raw silk — the native Japanese reading for unprocessed silk thread
- {絹糸|きぬいと}: silk thread — processed silk thread ready for weaving
- {絹|きぬ}: silk — the finished fabric material
